description: Find text anywhere on the phone in one call: rows in every app's data (contacts, messages, alarms, notes, tasks and any app you built) and notifications. Not case sensitive. Each hit says the app, the collection, the row id, the field that matched and a short snippet, with the full row. Use app to look in one app, or 'notifications'. Changes nothing.

query.description: Text to look for, up to 200 characters

name: search_phone
